paragraphs: I'm a technical co-founder and AI engineer who takes AI into operating businesses end to end: architecture, build, deployment, and the client relationship. I'm studying AI at the University of Miami Business School.

At Ktwo.ai (two co-founders; I own product and engineering), I rebuilt the platform from a Replit-generated prototype into an engineered codebase: an auth migration with mandatory 2FA, structural tenant isolation with tripwire tests, a deterministic agent orchestrator with prompt-injection isolation, and the repo's first test suite. I also completed a paid engagement auditing a venture-backed startup's codebase and AI implementation ahead of its $2.45M raise.

I'm an AI-native builder: Claude Code and Cursor are core to how I work, and I'm drawn to teams putting AI into actual operations rather than demoing it. I'm looking for an internship or part-time engineering role at a seed-to-Series A startup, starting now: remote or Miami in-person during the semester, open to relocating for the summer.

items.title: Technical Co-Founder
items.desc: Technical co-founder of Ktwo, an AI operations product for home-services businesses (two co-founders; I own product and engineering). Rebuilt the platform from a Replit-generated portal into an engineered codebase: decomposed a 2,500-line route monolith and a 3,600-line dashboard, removed 15k dead lines. Architected a three-stage agent pipeline: a Haiku classifier feeding a deterministic orchestrator, with Sonnet generating responses inside enforced business rules and prompt-injection isolation. Migrated to Supabase Auth with mandatory 2FA (TOTP and SMS), AAL2 enforcement, and audited time-boxed impersonation; moved rate-limit state into Postgres for multi-replica safety and enforced structural tenant isolation via a tenant-scoped query wrapper with a static tripwire test. Introduced the repo's first test suite (Vitest) and deployed to Railway behind a gated waitlist.

items.title: AI Consultant
items.desc: Contract engagement with a venture-backed consumer marketplace during its pre-seed phase, working directly with the founder and the development team. Audited the codebase, cloud infrastructure, and AI implementation; presented security, architecture, and cost findings with recommendations. Advised on AI integration strategy going into the raise: the company closed a $2.45M seed round following the engagement.

items.title: Founder & Lead Engineer
items.desc: Built and operated a client portal for small businesses (sole engineer, working with one non-technical partner): analytics dashboards, Stripe billing with webhook signature verification, support ticketing with Slack alerts, and five-tier RBAC. Signed and served the company's first paying client, a Danish wine retailer. After REST and GraphQL attempts failed, cracked the retailer's legacy SOAP/WSDL API and built a catalog sync into Postgres: roughly 430 products with images in about 40 seconds via a field-level diff upsert with orphan deletion. Built a React Native storefront and scaffolded the OnPay-to-DanDomain order loop; the app never launched, blocked on DanDomain's SOAP order API before the engagement ended.

items.title: Star Citizen Political Map
items.desc: A political map of the Star Citizen universe, drawn the way grand-strategy games draw galaxies: faction territories, hyperlane-style jump routes, and a route planner that respects ship size. One self-contained HTML file, no backend.
details: Double-click any of the 90 systems to open an orbital diagram of every planet, moon, station, and jump point on record, about 860 objects total
No border is hand-drawn: an ownership resolver decides who owns each system, then a Voronoi pass assigns every point in space to its nearest seed
Jittered grid of "void" seeds keeps deep space neutral; lane seeds make territory follow the jump network instead of blobbing
Cohesion handling: unclaimed systems get a weighted neutral pocket, and lane seeds are capped at a fixed reach from their endpoint
The engine has its own cohesion tests, and a Playwright script opens all 90 system views headlessly and fails the build on any page error
